description: Class representing a container for the paragraph elements.

AddComment.description:
Adds a comment to the current inline content control.
<note>Please note that this inline content control must be in the document.</note>

params.description: The comment text.
params.name: sText

params.description: The author's name.
params.name: sAuthor

params.description: The user ID of the comment author.
params.name: sUserId

returns.description: Returns null if the comment was not added.

AddComment.signature: AddComment(sText: string, sAuthor?: string, sUserId?: string): ApiComment

AddElement.description: Adds an element to the inline text content control.

params.description: The document element which will be added at the position specified. Returns **false** if the type of *oElement* is not supported by an inline text content control.
params.name: oElement

params.description: The position of the element where it will be added to the current inline text content control. If this value is not specified, then the element will be added to the end of the current inline text content control.
params.name: nPos

returns.description: returns false if oElement unsupported.

AddListItem.description: Adds an item to a combo box list or drop-down list.

params.description: The name of the item to add to the list.
params.name: name

params.description: The value of the item to add to the list.
params.name: value

params.description: The optional position at which to insert the new item in the list.
params.name: pos

returns.description: Returns `true` if the item was successfully added, otherwise `false`.

AddListItem.signature: AddListItem(name: string, value: string, pos?: number): boolean

AddText.description: Adds text to the current content control.

params.description: The text which will be added to the content control.
params.name: text

returns.description: returns null if content control can't be edited.

Copy.description: Creates a copy of an inline content control. Ignores comments, footnote references, complex fields.

Delete.description: Removes a content control and its content. If keepContent is true, the content is not deleted.

params.description: Specifies if the content will be deleted or not.
params.name: keepContent

returns.description: returns false if control haven't parent paragraph.

GetAlias.description: Returns the alias attribute for the current container.

GetAppearance.description: Returns the visualization type of the content control.

returns.description: type - The visualization type of the content control.

GetBackgroundColor.description: Returns the background color of the current content control.

GetBorderColor.description: Returns the border color of the current content control.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiInlineLvlSdt class.

GetColor.description: Returns the tag color of the content control.

returns.description: Returns the tag color, or _null_ if no color is set.

GetDataBinding.description: Retrieves the data binding of the content control.

returns.description: Returns the data binding of the content control if it exists, otherwise `null`.

GetDataForXmlMapping.description: Returns the content control data for the XML mapping.

returns.description: The string data representing the contents of the current content control.

GetDate.description:
Retrieves the selected date value from a date picker content control and returns it as a Date object.

Throws: Error if the content control is not a date picker.

returns.description: Date object representing the selected date in the date picker control, or undefined if the form is a placeholder.

GetDropdownList.description: Returns a list of values of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetElement.description: Returns an element of the current inline text content control using the position specified.

params.description: The position where the element which content we want to get must be located.
params.name: nPos

GetElementIndex.description: Returns the position (index) of the specified element within the current inline content control.

params.description: The inline element (run, inline content control, form, etc.) whose index will be returned.
params.name: element

returns.description: returns -1 if the element is not a direct child of the current inline content control.

GetElementsCount.description:
Returns a number of elements in the current inline text content control. The text content 
control is created with one text run present in it by default, so even without any 
element added this method will return the value of '1'.

GetId.description: Returns a unique ID for the current content control.

GetInternalId.description: Returns an internal ID of the current content control.

GetLabel.description: Returns the label attribute for the current container.

GetLock.description: Returns the lock type of the current container.

GetParent.description: Returns the parent element (a paragraph or an inline content control) that directly contains the current inline content control.

returns.description: returns null if the content control has no parent.

GetParentContentControl.description: Returns a content control that contains the current content control.

returns.description: returns null if parent content control doesn't exist.

GetParentParagraph.description: Returns a paragraph that contains the current content control.

returns.description: returns null if parent paragraph doesn't exist.

GetParentTable.description: Returns a table that contains the current content control.

returns.description: returns null if parent table doesn't exist.

GetParentTableCell.description: Returns a table cell that contains the current content control.

returns.description: return null if parent cell doesn't exist.

GetPlaceholderText.description: Returns the placeholder text from the current inline content control.

GetPosInParent.description: Returns the position (index) of the current inline content control within its parent element.

returns.description: returns -1 if the content control has no parent.

GetRange.description: Returns a Range object that represents the part of the document contained in the specified content control.

params.description: Start position index in the current element.
params.name: Start

params.description: End position index in the current element.
params.name: End

GetTag.description: Returns the tag attribute for the current container.

IsCheckBox.description: Checks if the content control is a checkbox.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the content control is a checkbox, otherwise `false`.

IsCheckBoxChecked.description:
Determines whether a checkbox content control is currently checked or unchecked.

Throws: Error if the content control is not a checkbox.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the checkbox is checked, `false` if the checkbox is unchecked.

IsComboBox.description: Checks whether the content control is a combo box list.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the content control is a combo box list, otherwise `false`.

IsDatePicker.description: Checks whether the content control is a datepicker.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the content control is a datepicker, otherwise `false`.

IsDropDownList.description: Checks whether the content control is a drop-down list.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the content control is a drop-down list, otherwise `false`.

IsForm.description: Checks if the content control is a form.

IsPicture.description:
Checks whether the content control is a picture control.
This method verifies if the content control is specifically a picture control.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the content control is a picture, otherwise `false`.

MoveCursorOutside.description: Places a cursor before/after the current content control.

params.description: Specifies whether a cursor will be placed before (false) or after (true) the current content control.
params.name: isAfter

Push.description: Adds an element to the end of inline text content control.

params.description: The document element which will be added to the end of the container.
params.name: oElement

returns.description: returns false if oElement unsupported.

RemoveAllElements.description: Removes all the elements from the current inline text content control.

returns.description: returns false if control has not elements.

RemoveElement.description: Removes an element using the position specified from the current inline text content control.

params.description: The position of the element which we want to remove from the current inline text content control.
params.name: nPos

RemoveListItem.description: Removes an item from a combo box list or drop-down list.

params.description: The value of the item to remove from the list.
params.name: value

returns.description: Returns `true` if the item was successfully removed, otherwise `false`.

SelectListItem.description: Sets the selected item for a combo box list or drop-down list.

params.description: The name of the item to be selected in the list.
params.name: name

returns.description: Returns `true` if the item was successfully selected, otherwise `false`.

SetAlias.description: Sets the alias attribute to the current container.

params.description: The alias which will be added to the current inline text content control.
params.name: sAlias

SetAppearance.description: Sets the visualization type of the content control.

params.description: The desired visualization type.
params.name: type

SetBackgroundColor.description: Sets the background color to the current content control.

params.description: The background color.
params.name: color

SetBorderColor.description: Sets the border color to the current content control.

params.description: The border color.
params.name: color

SetCheckBoxChecked.description:
Sets the checkbox value for the content control.
This method updates the checkbox state of the content control to either checked or unchecked.

params.description: The state to set for the checkbox. `true` for checked, `false` for unchecked.
params.name: isChecked

returns.description: Returns `true` if the checkbox value was successfully set, `false` if the content control is not a checkbox.

SetColor.description: Sets the tag color of the content control.

params.description: The tag color. Pass _null_ to remove the color.
params.name: color

SetDataBinding.description: Sets the data binding for the current content control.

params.description: The data binding to associate with the content control.
params.name: xmlMapping

SetDate.description: Sets the value for the datepicker content control.

params.description: The date value to set for the datepicker.
params.name: date

returns.description: Returns `true` if the date was successfully set, otherwise `false`.

SetDateFormat.description:
Sets the date format for the datepicker content control.
This method allows setting the format in which the date should be displayed in the datepicker content control.
The format string should be specified using common date format patterns (e.g., "mm.dd.yyyy").

params.description: The desired date format (e.g., "mm.dd.yyyy").
params.name: dateFormat

returns.description: Returns `true` if the date format was successfully set, otherwise `false`.

SetId.description: Specifies a unique ID for the current content control.

params.description: The numerical ID which will be specified for the current content control.
params.name: id

SetLabel.description: Adds a string label to the current inline text content control.

params.description: The label which will be added to the current inline text content control. Can be a positive or negative integer from **-2147483647** to **2147483647**.
params.name: label

SetLock.description:
Sets the lock to the current inline text content control:
**"unlocked"** - content can be edited and the container can be deleted.
**"contentLocked"** - content cannot be edited.
**"sdtContentLocked"** - content cannot be edited and the container cannot be deleted.
**"sdtLocked"** - the container cannot be deleted.

params.description: The lock type applied to the inline text content control.
params.name: lockType

SetPicture.description:
Sets the content (image) for the picture content control.
This method updates the picture inside a content control by setting an image from a provided URL.
The URL should be an internet link to the image.

params.description: The URL of the image to be used for the content control.Currently, only internet URLs are supported.
params.name: imageUrl

returns.description: Returns `true` if the image was successfully set, otherwise `false`.

SetPictureSize.description:
Sets the size for the picture in a content control.
This method adjusts the width and height of the image if the content control is a picture.

params.description: The desired image width .
params.name: width

params.description: The desired image height.
params.name: height

returns.description: Returns `true` if the size was successfully set, or `false` if the content control is not a picture.

SetPlaceholderText.description:
Sets the placeholder text to the current inline content control.
*Can't be set to checkbox or radio button*

params.description: The text that will be set to the current inline content control.
params.name: sText

SetTag.description: Adds a string tag to the current inline text content control.

params.description: The tag which will be added to the current inline text content control.
params.name: sTag

SetTextPr.description: Applies text settings to the content of the content control.

params.description: The properties that will be set to the content of the content control.
params.name: oTextPr

returns.description: this.

ToJSON.description: Converts the ApiInlineLvlSdt object into the JSON object.

params.description: Specifies if the used styles will be written to the JSON object or not.
params.name: bWriteStyles

UpdateFromXmlMapping.description: Updates the content control using the value from the XML mapping.

returns.description: Returns `true` if the update was successful, otherwise `false`.
